summary: Defines a conference event package for tightly coupled conferences using the SIP events framework, with the data format for notifications. Users can subscribe to a conference URI and are notified of changes such as who joined or left. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: You can ask a meeting room to tell you whenever someone comes in or leaves. This sets up that message service for internet conference calls.
